description: deepKeysIterator no longer short-circuits on an empty root object, so it falls through to the walk loop and yields a spurious empty-string path
productionImpact: Callers that iterate `deepKeys({})` to enumerate existing fields receive an empty-string key instead of an empty array, causing downstream code that builds flat maps or deletes by path to attempt operations on a phantom `''` key. Objects with real content are also skipped entirely because the guard now exits on non-empty input.
